# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

VerifyGrid provides security updates for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

VerifyGrid takes the security of its reconciliation engine and cryptographic audit logs seriously.

If you discover a security vulnerability, **please do NOT create a public GitHub issue.** Instead, report it through one of the following channels:

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting:** Use the "Report a vulnerability" button under the **Security** tab of the repository.
2. **Email Security Point of Contact:** Send details to `security@verifygrid.io` (or repository maintainer: [ThunderSkull7](https://github.com/ThunderSkull7)).

### Information to Include
- Detailed description of the vulnerability and attack vector.
- Steps to reproduce or proof-of-concept (PoC) code.
- Potential impact on financial data integrity, authentication bypass, or audit log tampering.
- Suggested remediation or patch, if available.

### Disclosure Policy
We follow coordinated vulnerability disclosure. You will receive an initial response acknowledging your report within 48 hours. We ask that you give us reasonable time to investigate, remediate, and verify the issue before any public disclosure.
